reason: Address passive 'do nothing' policy (94% Action 0) by adding dense velocity penalty during flight to discourage uncontrolled free-fall, and activating terminal success reward (+100) to provide a clear goal signal. Crash penalty remains dormant per reflection decision and retrieved memory indicating harsh failure penalties hindered learning in similar contexts.
changed_design: Added active velocity_control term: Penalize high velocity magnitude continuously during flight to incentivize braking
Activated terminal_success_reward (+100) in training reward when safe landing conditions are met at termination
Kept crash_penalty dormant to avoid discouraging exploration with harsh failure signals
risk: High velocity penalty might encourage hovering near ground if step cost is insufficient to drive descent
Terminal success threshold (velocity < 0.5) must be reachable; otherwise agent may give up on landing
Velocity penalty weight needs calibration to balance against fuel cost of braking

expected_metric_changes.fitness_score: Improve (less negative) as agent learns controlled descent

repeatable_bonus_safety_check: Terminal success reward is gated by 'terminated' flag, ensuring it can only be collected once per episode at the final step.
